title: Skillup Feedback Queue Durable Item Contract
description: Deferred DB-backed feedback queue item contract for Skillup answer/HOLD review. This schema defines minimized durable-record fields only; it is not persistence execution evidence.

persistence_mechanism.description: DB-backed queue is the deferred intended mechanism. This value does not prove that DB persistence executed.

feedback_id.description: Stable opaque feedback identifier. Must not encode raw text, internal paths, secrets, tokens, credentials, DSNs, or prompt contents.

origin_event_id.description: Safe origin event or trace pointer, not a raw event payload.

dedup_key.description: Idempotency key built from safe bounded identifiers and reason codes only.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp or deterministic contract timestamp. This field alone is not durable persistence proof.

safe_summary.description: Bounded reviewer triage summary only. Must not contain raw standard text, raw restricted prompt content, internal paths, file URIs, localhost URLs, hostnames, filesystem locations, secrets, DSNs, tokens, credentials, keys, service-account data, raw Bridge evidence payloads, or raw source payloads.

result_status.description: Safe selected-route result status metadata only; not a PASS claim.

answer_status.description: Safe selected-route answer status metadata only; answer text is not persisted.

evidence_required.description: Safe boolean copied from the selected public contract. HOLD normally requires evidence; OK normally does not.

review_required.description: Safe boolean copied from the selected public contract. HOLD normally requires review; OK normally does not.

evidence_count.description: Count only. Evidence bodies, raw excerpts, and answer text must not be persisted.

warning_codes.description: Safe warning codes only. Raw warning payloads or response bodies are forbidden.

raw_text_included.description: Hard durable-record assertion: raw standard text must not be persisted.

internal_path_included.description: Hard durable-record assertion: internal paths and filesystem locations must not be persisted.

db_access_executed.description: R9ZMH contract construction is no-DB. This false value is not persistence success evidence and must not be reused as DB-backed persistence PASS.
